steps.title: right-handed: its views
cmux: clear; D="${CMUX_CUSTOMIZE_DIR:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/cmux/customize}"; mkdir -p "$D" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/main.js" && echo  | base64 -d > "$D/cmux-app.json" && echo saved right-handed

steps.title: right-handed: The whole window mirrored: the sidebar on the right with the window buttons over the tab bar, the chat's prompt rail and Session Info chip on the right, spaces on top, a docked Chief on the left, and a compact hover card of your own.
